lead.title: Spiro Medical treats its first asthma patient with a spinal neuromodulation implant (PULSAR study)
lead.deck: First patient treated in the PULSAR feasibility study (FDA IDE, up to 30 patients, several US centers) for severe uncontrolled asthma: an implant stimulates spinal nerves to modulate bronchial tone. The Irvine, California company raised a $67M Series A in January led by Paris-based Andera Partners, with Omega Funds and Sherpa Healthcare Partners.

milestone.title: E2 wins dual FDA clearance for Hēlo Return, the first blood-return system cleared for use with continuous vacuum aspiration
milestone.summary: Hēlo Return collects and filters blood aspirated during venous thrombectomy (pulmonary embolism) and returns it to the patient; E2 claims "near-zero" blood loss in its ENGULF pivotal trial (company data). The Hēlo platform was cleared in December 2025.
milestone.why: Bleeding is the Achilles' heel of mechanical clot aspiration: built-in blood return widens the venous thrombectomy market. E2 raised an $80M Series C in April 2026.

deal.thesis: Steris is buying Xodus (Pink Pad patient positioning, See Sharp laparoscopic defogger; ~$245M of sales expected this year) for $2.1B, about $1.8B net of tax benefits, plus up to $150M of 2028 earn-out. A valuation comparable for recurring surgical consumables, not an entry opportunity.

brefsIntl.title: Abram Scientific wins up to $8.3M from DARPA (RAPIID program) for its CoagCare coagulation test
brefsIntl.summary: Point-of-care coagulation test returning results in about 10 minutes, still awaiting FDA clearance; the contract targets care of ischemia and bleeding in critical settings.

word.definition: An implant delivers small electrical pulses to the spinal cord or spinal nerves to alter nerve signaling, historically for chronic pain and now being tested for motor function, blood pressure and asthma.

parts.label: Electrodes (leads)
parts.role: contact with the cord or nerves

parts.label: Implanted pulse generator (IPG)
parts.role: the battery and brain of the system

parts.label: Programming / sensors
parts.role: tuning intensity, sometimes in closed loop

how.t: Electrodes are placed near the spinal cord or spinal nerves and connected to a generator under the skin.
Electrical pulses modulate targeted nerve pathways (pain, movement, autonomic system).
The clinician sets the program; some systems adapt stimulation to the measured nerve response.

word.why: A historic chronic-pain market widening into new indications (asthma, blood pressure, spinal cord injury): the VC angle is the shift from a niche product to a multi-indication platform, with costly pivotal trials and exits via strategic acquisition.

startups.name: Spiro Medical
startups.use: Spinal-nerve stimulation implant for severe asthma; first patient in the PULSAR study; $67M Series A led by Andera Partners.

startups.name: ONWARD Medical
startups.use: ARC-EX (external stimulation, in over 100 clinics) and ARC-IM (implant) for spinal cord injury; first patient implanted in the Empower BP pivotal study in Q1 2026.

startups.name: Saluda Medical
startups.use: Evoke closed-loop SCS system that measures the nerve response to adjust stimulation; ASX-listed since Dec. 2025.
